decision: captured the old site before touching it
why: so the change can be judged old against new

decision: fixed the broken build first by excluding repo tooling from tsconfig
why: every later check needs a green build to mean anything

decision: built 3 throwaway directions (dark cinematic, light editorial, product-page flip) before writing app code
why: the art direction is a one-way door, 3 sketches are cheaper than 1 wrong implementation
result: picked a synthesis: editorial paper body, dark hero and footer, glass header

decision: committed to one light-first art direction instead of a theme toggle
why: one mastered direction beats two half-tuned ones, and long-form reads better on light

decision: sketched the design tokens, type scale, and shell before any page
why: pages built on a fixed vocabulary come out consistent

decision: put experience, projects, and misc into one typed module and deleted lib/external-links.ts
why: one source of truth for shapes beats repeated prop assumptions
result: 7 files import it, no duplicate shapes

decision: added scripts/shoot.mjs with playwright-core for desktop and mobile screenshots, motion and reduced
why: visual work needs a committed, rerunnable check, not a one-time eyeball

decision: moved the preview to serve with cleanUrls
why: python http.server and -s fallback were serving the home page for extensionless routes, nearly verified the wrong page
result: every route resolves to its own HTML

decision: used CSS transitions plus one IntersectionObserver instead of an animation library
why: the installed stack already covers it, a library here is weight with no gain

decision: made card and row titles block elements
why: they rendered inline, so titles and descriptions ran together

decision: moved the hero glow out of the container into a full-bleed section
why: the ambient light was clipped into a visible rectangle
titles were unreadable on bright cover art

decision: wrote scripts/check.mjs covering console errors, tone flip, mobile menu, anchors, math and code highlight, 320px overflow, reduced motion, keyboard order
why: turns the visual invariants into a gate anyone can rerun

decision: ran Lighthouse and a real throttled LCP probe
why: wanted the honest number, not the simulated one
result: 93 perf, 100 a11y, 100 best practices, 100 SEO, CLS 0, TBT 10ms, throttled LCP 0.76s

why: metadata, sitemap, and robots need an absolute base, and the domain came from the email address
result: open, change if the production domain differs
